mergedParams.userDescription: Bouncy, elastic easing and overshoot. internal effects for text, video, images

output.title: Bouncy Elastic Easing with Overshoot for Media

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'ElasticBounce' that provides smooth elastic overshoot animations for any target element. The effect should use spring-based easing to create a bouncy, elastic feel with customizable overshoot amplitude. It should animate scale and rotate properties with a slight anticipation dip before the main motion, mimicking classic animation principles. The effect accepts parameters for duration (default 0.8s), overshoot intensity (0.1 to 0.5), and target element IDs. Use AnimationRange keyframes with at least 8 progression points to create smooth elastic curves, including an initial backward motion at prog 0.1, main motion peak at prog 0.7, overshoot at prog 0.85, and settle at prog 1.0.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: scale, scaleX, scaleY, rotate. AnimationRange structure with spring easing: [{prog: 0, val: 1}, {prog: 0.1, val: 0.95}, {prog: 0.7, val: 1.15}, {prog: 0.85, val: 1.08}, {prog: 0.95, val: 1.02}, {prog: 1, val: 1}]. Input params: z.object({duration: z.number().default(0.8), overshoot: z.number().min(0.1).max(0.5).default(0.3), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). Return format: {effects: [{type: 'generic', start: 0, duration, mode: 'provider', targetIds, ranges: AnimationRange[]}]}. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset named 'RubberBandSnap' that creates a rubber band-like snap-back effect for text elements. The effect should simulate stretching and releasing elastic material, with the text stretching horizontally (scaleX) while compressing vertically (scaleY) during the snap motion. Include translateY movement that creates a subtle bounce. The effect should have three phases: stretch (0-30%), snap release (30-70%), and elastic settle (70-100%). Accept parameters for snap intensity, direction (left/right/center), and custom easing curves. Use GPU-accelerated transforms only for optimal performance.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: scaleX, scaleY, translateY, translateX. Three-phase animation: stretch phase [{prog: 0, val: 1}, {prog: 0.3, val: 1.4}], snap phase [{prog: 0.3, val: 1.4}, {prog: 0.7, val: 0.85}], settle phase [{prog: 0.7, val: 0.85}, {prog: 0.85, val: 1.05}, {prog: 1, val: 1}]. Input params: z.object({intensity: z.number().default(1), direction: z.enum(['left', 'right', 'center']).default('center'), duration: z.number().default(0.6), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). Transform-only for GPU acceleration. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, ranges}]}.

prompts.prompt: Design an audio-reactive internal effect preset called 'BeatElastic' that responds to bass frequencies with elastic bounce animations. The effect should detect audio beats and trigger elastic scale pulses with overshoot, creating a bouncy, reactive feel synchronized to music. Combine waveform detection with elastic easing curves. The bounce intensity should vary based on bass amplitude, with stronger beats creating larger overshoots. Include a rebound phase where the element slightly undershoots before settling. Support both scale-only and scale-with-rotation modes for different visual styles.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (audio-reactive). Waveform config: {type: 'scale', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.8, threshold: 0.3, smoothing: 0.2}. Additional properties for rotation mode: {type: 'rotate', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.4}. Input params: z.object({mode: z.enum(['scale', 'scale-rotate']).default('scale'), sensitivity: z.number().min(0.1).max(1).default(0.8), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). Return combined effects array for scale-rotate mode: {effects: [{type: 'waveform', props: scaleConfig}, {type: 'waveform', props: rotateConfig}]}. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}.

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal effect preset 'JellyWobble' that creates a jelly-like wobble effect with elastic deformation. The effect should simulate soft-body physics by combining multiple transform properties in offset phases. Use scaleX and scaleY in opposite phases to create squash-and-stretch, while adding subtle rotation wobbles. The animation should have a primary wobble followed by decreasing secondary wobbles (damped oscillation). Accept parameters for wobble count (1-5), stiffness (how quickly it settles), and mass (affects wobble speed). Perfect for UI elements that need playful, organic motion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Multi-property animation with phase offsets. ScaleX ranges: oscillating pattern with decreasing amplitude. ScaleY ranges: inverse of scaleX for squash-stretch. Rotate ranges: slight wobble (-5 to 5 degrees). Damped oscillation formula for secondary wobbles. Input params: z.object({wobbleCount: z.number().int().min(1).max(5).default(3), stiffness: z.number().default(0.3), mass: z.number().default(1), duration: z.number().default(1.2), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). Calculate prog values dynamically based on wobble count. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: [...scaleXRanges, ...scaleYRanges, ...rotateRanges]}]}.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'SpringLoad' that simulates a spring-loaded mechanism with tension and release. The effect should start with a backward pull (like drawing a bowstring), hold briefly with subtle tension vibration, then release with explosive forward motion and elastic overshoot. Include micro-animations during the tension phase using high-frequency, low-amplitude oscillations. Support directional variants (up, down, left, right) and accept parameters for tension duration, release speed, and vibration intensity. Use translateX/Y for direction and scale for impact emphasis.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Three-phase animation: pull-back (0-30%), tension-hold (30-50%) with micro-vibrations, release (50-100%). Direction-based translate values. Micro-vibration: rapid prog increments with alternating small values. Input params: z.object({direction: z.enum(['up', 'down', 'left', 'right']).default('right'), tensionDuration: z.number().default(0.3), releaseSpeed: z.number().default(1.5), vibrationIntensity: z.number().default(0.02), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). Calculate translate values based on direction. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: [...translateRanges, ...scaleRanges, ...vibrationRanges]}]}.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset 'ElasticGlitch' that combines elastic motion with glitch-style interruptions. The effect should perform smooth elastic animations but randomly introduce brief 'glitch' moments where the motion stutters, jumps, or distorts before continuing the elastic curve. Use a combination of transform properties and filter effects (blur, brightness flickers) during glitch frames. The glitches should feel intentional and rhythmic, not truly random. Accept parameters for glitch frequency, intensity, and whether to include color shifts. Perfect for modern, edgy UI animations.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined (generic + filter effects). Base elastic animation with inserted glitch frames. Glitch points at specific prog values (0.25, 0.5, 0.75). Transform glitches: sudden position/scale jumps. Filter glitches: blur spikes, brightness flashes. Input params: z.object({glitchFrequency: z.number().default(3), glitchIntensity: z.number().default(0.5), includeColorShift: z.boolean().default(false), duration: z.number().default(1), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: transformRanges}, {type: 'generic', ranges: filterRanges}]}. Use sharp prog transitions for glitch moments.

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset 'BouncePath' that creates bouncing motion along a curved path, like a ball bouncing across the screen. The effect should combine horizontal translation with parabolic vertical motion, where each bounce has decreasing height (gravity simulation). Add squash-and-stretch deformation at impact points and slight rotation during flight. Accept parameters for bounce count, gravity strength, initial velocity, and elasticity (how much energy is retained per bounce). The path should feel physically accurate while maintaining the playful elastic character.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Physics-based calculation for bounce paths. TranslateY: parabolic arcs with decreasing amplitude. TranslateX: linear progression. ScaleY: compression at impact points (prog values where translateY = 0). ScaleX: inverse of scaleY for volume preservation. Rotate: slight spin during flight phases. Input params: z.object({bounceCount: z.number().int().min(1).max(5).default(3), gravity: z.number().default(9.8), initialVelocity: z.number().default(10), elasticity: z.number().min(0.1).max(1).default(0.7), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). Calculate impact points and peak heights using physics formulas. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: [...translateXRanges, ...translateYRanges, ...scaleRanges, ...rotateRanges]}]}.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'ElasticReveal' optimized for text and image reveal animations. The effect should unveil content with elastic overshoot on multiple properties simultaneously: opacity fade-in, scale from 0.7 to 1 with overshoot to 1.1, and slight rotation that settles to 0. Include a subtle blur-to-focus transition for added depth. The reveal should feel like the element is emerging from elastic resistance. Support stagger delays for multi-element reveals and accept parameters for overshoot amount, blur intensity, and reveal origin (center, top, bottom, left, right).
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Multi-property reveal animation. Opacity: [{prog: 0, val: 0}, {prog: 0.3, val: 0.8}, {prog: 1, val: 1}]. Scale: elastic curve from 0.7 to 1.1, settling at 1. Rotate: -5deg to 5deg to 0deg. Blur: 10px to 0px with easing. Input params: z.object({overshoot: z.number().default(0.1), blurIntensity: z.number().default(10), origin: z.enum(['center', 'top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']).default('center'), staggerDelay: z.number().default(0), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). Transform-origin based on origin param. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: [...opacityRanges, ...scaleRanges, ...rotateRanges, ...blurRanges]}]}.

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal effect preset 'FrequencyBounce' that creates different elastic behaviors based on audio frequency bands. Low frequencies (bass) trigger heavy, slow elastic bounces with large overshoot. Mid frequencies create medium-speed wobbles. High frequencies produce rapid, small elastic vibrations. The effect should blend all three frequency responses into a complex, layered elastic animation. Include smoothing to prevent jarring transitions and support sensitivity adjustment per frequency band. Perfect for creating rich, audio-reactive elastic animations.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (audio-reactive, multi-frequency). Three parallel waveform effects for different frequency bands. Bass effect: {type: 'scale', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 1, smoothing: 0.3}. Mid effect: {type: 'rotate', audioProperty: 'mid', sensitivity: 0.7, smoothing: 0.2}. Treble effect: {type: 'translate', audioProperty: 'treble', sensitivity: 0.5, smoothing: 0.1}. Input params: z.object({bassSensitivity: z.number().default(1), midSensitivity: z.number().default(0.7), trebleSensitivity: z.number().default(0.5), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). Return: {effects: [bassEffect, midEffect, trebleEffect]}. Each frequency band affects different transform properties for layered animation.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset 'MagneticSnap' that simulates magnetic attraction with elastic resistance. The effect should start with slow acceleration as if fighting against elastic resistance, then rapidly accelerate (magnetic pull overcomes elasticity), and finish with a satisfying elastic snap into place. Include subtle oscillation after snapping, like a magnet settling. Add optional 'repel' mode where the animation reverses, simulating magnetic repulsion with elastic pushback. Support attraction strength and elastic resistance as separate parameters for fine control over the motion dynamics.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Non-linear acceleration curve mimicking magnetic forces. Translate ranges: slow start (0-40%), rapid acceleration (40-70%), elastic snap (70-100%). Scale: slight compression during acceleration, expansion on snap. Post-snap oscillation: 3-4 small wobbles with decreasing amplitude. Input params: z.object({mode: z.enum(['attract', 'repel']).default('attract'), attractionStrength: z.number().default(2), elasticResistance: z.number().default(1), settleTime: z.number().default(0.3), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). Calculate acceleration curve based on strength/resistance ratio. Reverse ranges for repel mode. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: [...translateRanges, ...scaleRanges, ...oscillationRanges]}]}.
